why: QW-SLICE2R 10-20 Q.STA.SLICE.2: slice2 VM8 leaf group (6 CLOSED single-root leaves: vmr x3, crom, btab, prog) as a LANDED parent. Option P1 (each leaf its own clock region): measured leaf boundary insertion TT 264 (vmr) .. 376 (crom) ps / FF 216 .. 309 ps differs by 112 / 93 ps and the group spans ~1.1 x 1.0 mm, so one parent region (P2') would need per-leaf clock compensation plus a <= 80 ps tree over ~1 mm (vm8b measured 100 ps over 0.78 mm). Every port is in r_io (the SU / slice2-core neighbour), every port <-> leaf net lands in a D4 / E2 ring (share_rings: one write ring per bus, one read per receiving leaf).

Reset alignment is carried by the region audit + the recorded reset depth 4 / t(child) 3
